Yes.

> Also, can disciplines be put on uncontrolled
> vampires? e.g. Sarah Brando (uncontrolled) has

> potence put on her, but is brough into play by

> spending 4 pool instead of the normal 3.

No. Cards can only target cards that are in play, by default.
